name: Tracker Simulator
description: Per-torrent stealth seeding simulator for testing a tracker and its anti-bot checks. For torrents you switch on in the torrent's menu, it announces to their trackers as stable, human-looking peers whose uploaded and downloaded counters grow gradually. Use it only against trackers you operate or have permission to test. It does not transfer any data.

settings.label: Stealth level
settings.help: basic, medium, high or maximum. More irregularity in announce timing and between peers. Default: high.

settings.label: Custom peer id prefix
settings.help: Up to 8 characters, for the custom profile, for example -XX0100-.

settings.label: Announce interval (ms)
settings.help: Typical time between announces when the tracker gives no interval or Follow tracker data is off. Real trackers usually ask for 1800 s. Default: 30000.

settings.label: Announce jitter (%)
settings.help: How far each gap may stray from the interval. Default: 25.

settings.label: Longest first delay (ms)
settings.help: Each peer waits a random time up to this before its first announce. Default: 15000.

settings.label: Info hash encoding
settings.help: raw (the standard) or hex, for a tracker that expects the hash as text. Default: raw.

settings.label: API key parameter
settings.help: Query parameter that carries the tracker API key below. Default: apikey.

settings.label: Extra query parameters
settings.help: Added to every tracker request, for example passkey=abc123.

settings.label: Proxy mode
settings.help: none, shared (every peer uses the first proxy below) or per_peer (peer N uses proxy N; a peer without a proxy does not run, so it never announces from your real address). A peer keeps the proxy it was given. Default: none.

settings.label: Proxies
settings.help: Tracker requests of a peer go through its proxy. Addresses start with socks5h:// (recommended), socks5://, http:// or https://.

settings.label: Outbound address
settings.help: A local IP address of this computer to send from when no proxy is used (picks the network card).

settings.label: Data folder
settings.help: Where state.json is kept. Default: a .tracker-sim folder beside the plugin folders, so updating the plugin doesn't touch it.

settings.label: Log level
settings.help: error, warn, info or debug. Default: info.

torrent_settings.label: Client
torrent_settings.help: Which client the peers pretend to be. auto: a mix. custom uses the custom peer id and user agent from the plugin settings. debug_obvious: an obvious -DRSIM0- peer id, for finding the bots in tracker logs. Each client has its own peers, so a peer keeps its id when you switch back.

option_help.auto: A mix of clients: each simulated peer gets one of qBittorrent, Transmission or Deluge and keeps it.
option_help.qbittorrent: Every peer announces like qBittorrent: its peer id, User-Agent and query layout.
option_help.transmission: Every peer announces like Transmission: its peer id, User-Agent and query layout.
option_help.deluge: Every peer announces like Deluge (libtorrent): its peer id, User-Agent and query layout.
option_help.custom: Uses the custom peer id prefix and User-Agent from the plugin settings.
option_help.debug_obvious: Peers announce an obvious -DRSIM0- id, so you can find the simulated peers in your tracker logs.

torrent_settings.label: Mode
torrent_settings.help: seed_only: has everything and uploads. partial_seed / download_and_seed: has part or none and downloads the rest. loopback_pair: the peers move real data between themselves on this computer (needs 2 or more).

option_help.seed_only: Peers have the whole torrent and only upload. Downloaded counters stay at zero.
option_help.partial_seed: Peers start with part of the torrent, download the rest, then upload.
option_help.download_and_seed: Peers start with nothing, download everything, then keep uploading.
option_help.loopback_pair: Peers swap real data with each other on this computer, so the counters are bytes that really moved. Needs 2 or more peers.

torrent_settings.label: Peers
torrent_settings.help: How many simulated peers, 1 to 20. Each has its own peer ID, port and timing.

torrent_settings.label: Upload speed pattern
torrent_settings.help: How the upload speed moves between min and max.

option_help.constant_jitter: Steady: stays near the middle of min and max and wobbles about 15%. Looks like a seedbox with a stable line.
option_help.random_walk: Drifts: the speed wanders up and down between min and max in smooth steps, like a connection shared with other traffic.
option_help.bursty: Stop and go: quiet stretches (little or no upload), short fast bursts near the max, and normal stretches in between. Like peers that get requests in waves.

option_help.constant_jitter: Steady: stays near the middle of min and max and wobbles about 15%.
option_help.random_walk: Drifts: the speed wanders up and down between min and max in smooth steps.
option_help.bursty: Stop and go: quiet stretches, short fast bursts near the max, and normal stretches in between.

torrent_settings.label: Partial seed share (%)
torrent_settings.help: How much of the torrent a partial_seed peer starts with.

option_help.sequential: Asks for pieces in order, first to last. Easy to read in logs; like streaming mode.
option_help.random: Asks for pieces in random order.
option_help.rarest_first: Asks for the pieces the fewest peers have first, as most real clients do.
option_help.endgame_bias: Like rarest first, but near the end asks several peers for the last pieces at once.

torrent_settings.label: Follow tracker data
torrent_settings.help: Use the tracker's interval and its seeder and leecher counts.

torrent_settings.label: Ignore tracker demand
torrent_settings.help: Keep uploading (or downloading) at the set speeds even when the tracker shows no leechers (or no seeders). Off: with nobody to give to, the simulation idles until the tracker's numbers change.

torrent_settings.label: Daily activity pattern
torrent_settings.help: Quieter at night, with a slow day-to-day drift.
